text:
Then they grow grain on an altar in Chile

Then they pour milk into an old cannon

Then they pile firewood from poisoned arrows

Then they plant rice in an abandoned bastion


Then they play hide-and-seek in an empty parliament

Then they play ball with innocent bombs

Then they play chess with tiny pieces

of what was once a great president


Then they grow wine on stony Mafia soil

Then they sacrifice goats and lambs at a bank

Then they drive around Sofia in a Rolls-Royce

Then they burn rubles and dollars and francs


Then they sing songs about the happiness of peoples

Then they sing songs about the grief of peoples

Then they sweep all the parties away like a gale

and bring down the castle of the last paper tiger.

translation.title: Then They Grow Grain on an Altar in Chile…
